## Objective

Using only existing H6 generators and Ridge research entry points, directly certify geo-baseline and
bounded Fourier/trend time-baseline recovery against known H6 nuisance truth, while correcting the
serial summaries and determining whether the prior conclusion remains true: nuisance correction
improves residual fit but does not restore media-response recovery.

This is evidence only. It does not implement or authorize production behavior.

## Fixed candidate matrix and boundary

Use exactly the five existing deterministic H6 pilot worlds and seeds 6600--6604:

- `WORLD-H6-PILOT-RETAIL-FULL-CONTROLS`
- `WORLD-H6-PILOT-RETAIL-OMITTED-CONTROLS`
- `WORLD-H6-PILOT-RETAIL-MEDIA-CORRELATED-CONTROLS`
- `WORLD-H6-PILOT-CPG-FULL-CONTROLS`
- `WORLD-H6-PILOT-AUTO-OMITTED-CONTROLS`

Use exactly these candidates:

A. current global-intercept Ridge + pooled media/controls;
B. known-geo effects + pooled media/controls;
C. B plus the already-established bounded Fourier/trend basis.

No saturated week effects, new time basis, new estimator, partial pooling, Bayesian authority,
or production behavior.

Fit all outcome-dependent transforms, hyperparameters, coefficients, and nuisance parameters on
weeks `0:39`; evaluate known geos on weeks `39:52`. Use the +10% raw all-media intervention
only on holdout weeks, full chronological recursive media state, fixed nuisance between baseline and
plan, and equal-row mean. Truth remains independent: raw H6 media, each `transform_truth`, full
adstock/Hill recursion, row/geo-specific `true_beta_gc`.

## Required evidence

For every world and candidate, persist machine-readable rows and report:

1. corrected serial structure: lag-1 correlations within each geo only, plus the defined aggregate
   (arithmetic mean) and per-geo values; no cross-geo boundary pairs;
2. fitted geo nuisance recovery versus `true_alpha_g` wherever the DGP exposes it, with error,
   correlation/sign where meaningful, and sparse-versus-observed summaries;
3. fitted bounded time nuisance recovery versus the known DGP common seasonal/time baseline
   (the H6 sinusoidal baseline) where exposed, with error and correlation; disclose that shocks and
   omitted controls are not the smooth baseline;
4. held-out log diagnostics and current plain-exp level diagnostics marked diagnostic-only;
5. pooled beta recovery, sign, relative error, per-channel contribution recovery, contribution-sum
   closure, and full-panel held-out Delta-mu recovery;
6. residual geo/time pattern, corrected serial structure, descriptive heteroskedasticity;
7. national/local variation, design rank/rank deficiency, and conditioning diagnostics;
8. stability for sparse versus sufficiently observed geos; if a metric is not validly measurable,
   state why rather than substituting residual fit.

Separate nuisance-truth recovery from residual-fit improvement. Do not call variation or conditioning
causal identification. Distinguish known-geo future prediction from unseen-geo behavior.

## Preregistered interpretation

Before empirical runs, record the exact deterministic matrix, formulas, leakage boundary, and
interpretation bands in the report. Reuse only existing research bands:

- absolute Delta-mu error <=0.02 high/low; >0.02--0.05 intermediate/material; >0.05 large;
- geo/time nuisance recovery error and correlation: descriptive research metrics, not release gates;
- serial, heteroskedasticity, rank, conditioning, and sparse/observed changes: descriptive;
- no metric authorizes production implementation.

The written conclusion must explicitly compare nuisance-truth recovery with residual improvement and
state whether media-response non-recovery persists.
